mapper.sql: select log_id, call_time, kind, scene, config_id, config_name, model_type, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, input_price, output_price, cost_amount, elapsed_ms, attempts, result, fail_reason, trace_id, create_time from ai_model_call_log
mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_call_log (call_time, kind, scene, config_id, config_name, model_type, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, input_price, output_price, cost_amount, elapsed_ms, attempts, result, fail_reason, trace_id) values (#{callTime}, #{kind}, #{scene}, #{configId}, #{configName}, #{modelType}, #{modelName}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{inputPrice}, #{outputPrice}, #{costAmount}, #{elapsedMs}, #{attempts}, #{result}, #{failReason}, #{traceId})
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejectCalls, ifnull(sum(case when attempts > 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as retryCalls, ifnull(sum(prompt_tokens), 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sum(completion_tokens), 0) as completionTokens, ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(cost_amount), 0) as costAmount, ifnull(round(avg(elapsed_ms), 0), 0) as avgElapsedMs, ifnull(max(elapsed_ms), 0) as maxElapsedMs from ai_model_call_log where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day)
select count(*) from ai_call_record where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day)

select date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as period, count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejectCalls, ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(cost_amount), 0) as costAmount, ifnull(round(avg(elapsed_ms), 0), 0) as avgElapsedMs from ai_model_call_log where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by period

select ifnull(model_name, '未知模型') as modelName, ifnull(max(model_type), '') as modelType, count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejectCalls, ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(cost_amount), 0) as costAmount, ifnull(round(avg(elapsed_ms), 0), 0) as avgElapsedMs from ai_model_call_log where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by model_name order by costAmount desc, totalCalls desc

select kind, scene, count(*) as totalCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failCalls, ifnull(sum(case when result = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejectCalls, ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens, ifnull(sum(cost_amount), 0) as costAmount, ifnull(round(avg(elapsed_ms), 0), 0) as avgElapsedMs from ai_model_call_log where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by kind, scene order by totalCalls desc
